race.comment: LAKE AGAWAM (7) is back after a six-month spell. Has won when fresh in the past and a couple of recent placings in Strathalbyn jump-outs suggest he is forward in his prep and can win again. BENDING AWAY (3) last raced six months ago. Impressively took out a race over this course and distance last time in work. Beaten a long neck in a trial here on 21 September so she looks ready to make her presence felt. ALFANO (5) makes his first appearance since April and is out to break a winless run going back to June 2023. Placed at five of ten visits to Port Lincoln. Good each-way option. Veteran RIVERSIDE ROCK (11) is back for an eighth campaign and makes his 50th appearance at Port Lincoln. Gets in with a featherweight after the claim so don't take him lightly. CHESTERAY (1) has won twice when fresh in the past so he must be considered first-up after a 27-week spell.
